game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel. Each round, a new lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the duel_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 390 points of lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Rule Duel
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lighthouse Point'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how duel_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
